purpose: Executable-scenario specifications for the engine spike and later IDE acceptance; not test results or supplied fixture projects.

selectionPolicy.required_core: S4-00 proves a minimal real workflow for the candidate; later owner-card acceptance still requires complete integration. A failure needs repair or a different candidate, not fake success.
selectionPolicy.depth_probe: S4-00 may record supported/partial/unsupported with actual evidence; full acceptance belongs to ownerCard and gaps remain open.
selectionPolicy.later_acceptance: Not required for engine admission; specified now for the named future card.
selectionPolicy.windows: Use the actual workplace OS/architecture. A macOS result cannot close the Windows requirement.
selectionPolicy.measurements: Record exact hardware, cold/warm state, dataset, engine/extensions, times and resource usage. No invented scores.
selectionPolicy.conditional_backend_probe: Run when the corresponding backend is an admissible candidate. Without a usable license/package record explicit not_available with reason; this does not block the OSS path. If selected for integration, its conditions become mandatory.

fixtures.evidenceRequired: Точные package hashes, API/engine versions, capability receipts и host logs.
